Deliverable written to `/home/kara/dagger-0959/`:

- `SOLUTION.md` — self-contained write-up (title, root-cause analysis, exact fix, verification)
- `scripts/triage_go_race_flake.sh` — automated DAGGER-0959 triage playbook
- `scripts/gitreins-tier1-go-leg.sh` — diff-scoped replacement for the hardcoded full-suite pre-commit leg

## Summary

**Root cause (two defects):**
1. **Test defect** — `TestExecuteRetrySettlement` asserts on a wall-clock retry window; under host load + race-detector overhead + parallel package execution, the scheduler settles outside the tolerance. Green standalone, red in-suite, count varies.
2. **Guard defect** — GitReins tier-1 hardcodes `go test -race ./...`, so every commit is gated on every package with no retry and no flake ledger, turning an unrelated transient into a guaranteed commit-time blocker.

**Verified resolution:**
- Triage (standalone green + no diff connectivity) → record a flake row, do **not** re-dispatch.
- Durable guard: compute the reverse-dependency closure of the diff and run only those packages, with a bounded standalone retry; keep the full suite in tier-2.
- Optional hardening: inject a fake clock into `TestExecuteRetrySettlement`.

**Verification** — I built a mock module reproducing the exact suite-red/standalone-green signature and ran every branch end-to-end:

| Branch | Result |
|---|---|
| Reproduce signature | ✅ |
| Flake classified + ledger row, `exit 0` | ✅ |
| Same-package diff → blocked as regression | ✅ |
| Transitive-dep diff → blocked as regression | ✅ |
| Reproducible failure → blocked, no row | ✅ |
| Guard skips unaffected packages | ✅ |
| Guard covers reverse-dep closure | ✅ |
| Guard retries then fails closed | ✅ |

Both scripts pass `bash -n`; `shellcheck` isn't installed in this environment.
